name: dsh-llm-acp
description: Expose local ACP CLI agents (kiro-cli, codebuddy, …) as DeepSeek Harness LLM provider routes, with a usage console and one-click CLI setup

scripts.test: node test/discover.mjs && node test/quota-probe.mjs && node test/dashboard-async.mjs && node test/errors-port.mjs && node test/backoff-port.mjs && node test/models-cache-port.mjs && node test/credits-port.mjs && node test/effort-port.mjs && node test/askuser-port.mjs && node test/usage-metrics.mjs && node test/version-sync.mjs && node test/retry-delay.mjs && node test/latest-check.mjs && node test/version-state.mjs && node test/i18n.mjs && node test/rank.mjs

releaseNotes: 洞察页新增「模型性价比排行」：服务端每 5 分钟采集各渠道模型列表，按免费 → 低 → 中 → 高倍率排名，默认按渠道分组，可切全部混排、只看免费
排行附近 7 天的成功率、耗时和限流次数，成功率低的模型会标警示并排到同档后面
记录 7 天内的新增、下架、倍率变化和新出现的免费模型；「立即重新采集」可马上刷新
采集间隔可用 rankIntervalMs 配置（0 = 只手动采集）；模型描述里只写 x0.29 这种倍率也能识别
